notes.title: Announcement regarding Demo Update!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, this is Bridge Music![/p][p]First of all, we would like to sincerely thank all of you who have been enjoying the demo.[/p][p][/p][p]Originally, we had planned to end the demo service with the completion of our Tumbler project. However, thanks to many requests from users, we have decided to keep the demo available for the time being![/p][p]That being said, in order to focus on content development, we will temporarily pause demo updates.[/p][p]We will do our best to bring you even more exciting DODORI content![/p][p][/p][p]Every word and piece of feedback you share with us truly means a lot and is a great source of encouragement for our team✨[/p][p]Thank you for always supporting us![/p][p][/p][p]* You can check out the latest updates on DODORI via our Discord![/p]

notes.title: [DODORI Demo] Update #4 is Complete!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
Update #4 is now live!

🎵 Features marked with this icon reflect feedback from our players.
Thank you so much for your continued interest and detailed reports!

[b][Improvements][/b]

1. 🎵 Options Menu – Added settings for note judgement timing and audio delay adjustment.
2. 🎵 Options Menu – Added settings for screen mode, resolution, and graphics quality.
3. Reduced the note stuttering effect when the note line moves during stage play.

[b][Bug Fixes][/b]

1. Options Menu – Resetting keyboard keys now defaults to F / J instead of Space / Enter.
2. Options Menu – Fixed an issue where no warning appeared when assigning duplicate keyboard keys.
3. Fixed an issue where pause menu animations did not reset correctly when pausing during stage play.

notes.title: [DODORI Demo] Update #3 is Complete!

Many of you shared feedback regarding the Skill Notes feature — we're still running internal tests and reviews to ensure it's polished before release.
We’re working hard to deliver a more complete and satisfying gameplay experience. Thank you for your continued support![/p][p][/p][p]🎵 Features marked with this icon are based on user feedback.  
We sincerely appreciate your interest and reports!

notes.title: [DODORI Demo] Update #2 is Complete!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Update #2 is now live!
(We highly recommend playing a round of DODORI over the upcoming holiday..ദ്ദിᐢ._.ᐢ₎)

🎵 The icon indicates features based on user feedback.
Thank you so much for your continued interest and reports!

[b][New Content][/b]

1. 🎵 Rhythm Mode – Precision Judgement Mode has been added!
This is currently a temporary implementation, so judgement range and visibility may lack polish. We always welcome feedback and bug reports!
Press the X button on the stage selection screen to toggle the mode ON/OFF.

2. Two new Hexagonal Note Line stages have been added to Rhythm Mode!
Enjoy the new stage "Under the Blossom" and the nostalgic "Falling Snowy" — both are available to play now!

[b][Improvements][/b]

1. 🎵 Improved visibility when a difficulty is selected on the stage selection screen.
2. 🎵 Removed the PLAY button from the stage selection screen — selecting a difficulty now takes you straight to the gameplay screen.
3. You can now toggle background video playback with a shortcut key on the stage selection screen.
4. If a stage doesn't have a dedicated background video, the ON/OFF icon will now appear deactivated.
5. Level indicators have been added above the difficulty buttons for each song to help you identify difficulty at a glance.
6. 🎵 A shortcut key has been added to allow quick restart from the result screen.
7. The town minimap now rotates based on the camera angle.

[b][Bug Fixes][/b]

1. Fixed an issue where only one SFX played when multiple Miss judgements occurred consecutively during stage play.

notes.title: [DODORI Demo] Update #1 is Complete!
notes.content:
🎵 The icon indicates features based on user feedback.
Even if some suggestions weren't included in this update, we're doing our best to implement them as soon as possible!
Thank you so much for your interest and all your reports!

[b][Improvements][/b]
[olist]
[*] 🎵 Note hit keys have been changed from Enter and Space to F and J. You can now customize your key settings in the options menu!
[*] 🎵 Shadows have been added to note lines and notes to improve visibility.
[*] 🎵 The trumpet part in the "The Snack Thief" stage has been adjusted to match the music more accurately.
[*] 🎵 The spacing of triplet notations in both "The Snack Thief" and "Rainbow Cat" stages has been unified.
[*] The note lines now appear in advance on the "SARA" and "SEHA's Story" stages to help you prepare for the performance.
[*] The key sound effects in the "Tutorial" stage have been improved.
[*] 🎵 The playtime of the pudding mini-game has been shortened, and sound effects have been enhanced.
[*] 🎵 Mouse input is now available when the screen is rotated.
[*] 🎵 When moving from the school to the town, Sara now spawns in front of the stairs.
[*] 🎵 Sprint state is now maintained when changing locations. 
[*] 🎵 A tutorial on sprinting will now appear the first time you enter the town.
[/olist]

[b][Bug Fixes] [/b]
[olist]
[*] 🎵 Fixed an issue where difficulty selection did not work properly with a gamepad on the stage selection screen.
[*] 🎵 Fixed an issue where scores were not displayed on the stage selection screen.
[*] 🎵 Fixed an issue where assigning Q or E in the key settings menu would also trigger tab switching.
[*] 🎵 Fixed an issue where gamepad buttons could be assigned to keyboard keys in the key settings menu. 
[*] 🎵 Fixed an issue where pressing the gamepad's X button would remove previously assigned keyboard keys.
[*] 🎵 Fixed an issue where movement was blocked when going up the stairs in Sara's house.
[*] 🎵 Fixed an issue where the microphone object had an outline before the “Let’s Start Band Practice!” quest was accepted.
[*] 🎵 Fixed an issue where the labels for "Rotate" and "Move" were shown incorrectly in camera mode.
[/olist]

notes.title: Hello! We're "BridgeMusic"!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello! We're "BridgeMusic"![/h2]

It's my first time greeting you.
We are the BridgeMusic team that is developing the game 'DODORI'.

Six people whose lives are in the game are gathering together to create fun with stories and music.
Our first work, "DODORI," is a story-oriented rhythm adventure game with a different sensibility from the existing high school girl band. You will soon see the story of Sara and her friends playing with music.

[h2]Please play the demo![/h2]

The demo will be released from May 14th to May 26th. You can play it for free on the Steam page during that period, so please pay a lot of attention!

The precious opinions from users are very helpful in making fun games!
Please also make sure to get your Steam wishlist, and we will be more committed to developing to release good games. Thank you always!
